page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.13xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on KVM virtualization and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance allocates 56 dedicated virtual CPUs across 28 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. Hardware resources include 224 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. Cache allocation includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX, AVX-512F, and AES-NI instruction sets.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating network-attached cloud storage for all persistent file systems and operating system volumes. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. The configuration features zero GPUs, focusing resources exclusively on standard CPU execution and large-footprint memory access.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.sn2.13xlarge within the middle 50 percent for parallel compute capacity, achieving a multi-core Geekbench score of 9393.0 and a stress-ng multi-core result of 40921.64. Memory throughput reaches 104.7 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 50.68 GB/sec for writes. Real-world tests demonstrate sustained throughput, recording 37.85 million Redis SET operations per second and 21.99 GB/sec in static web serving. Conversely, single-thread performance is constrained, falling into the bottom quartile with a Geekbench single-core score of 943.0 and poor gzip compression rates.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides substantial aggregate multi-threaded capacity and memory density without the overhead of specialized accelerator hardware. Because single-thread execution is modest, the server yields the highest efficiency when running highly parallelized tasks rather than latency-bound single-threaded processes. Suitable deployments include distributed caching layers, multi-worker enterprise application servers, batch data processing, Clang software builds, and mid-tier relational database hosting backed by remote block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.13xlarge is a general-purpose instance providing 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224 GB of system memory on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz. Operating on a KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture, it incorporates AVX-512 extensions, 35 MB of L3 cache, and a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The server includes no integrated local storage and no GPUs, utilizing a 10 Gbps baseline network interface to access network-attached block devices. Benchmarking reveals solid multi-core performance, evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 9393.0, uncached memory read bandwidth of 104.7 GB/sec, and 37.85 million Redis SET operations per second. However, single-core processing metrics remain in the lower quartile. The hardware configuration delivers steady throughput for highly parallel workloads, making it well matched for multi-threaded application servers, distributed Redis caching, static web hosting, and batch compilation pipelines.
